system.terrain: Variable. _Load:_ 500 cn x HD at full movement rate, or 1,000 cn X its HD at half movement rate.
system.monsterType: Construct, Enchanted (Rare). A golem is a "construct," a powerful, enchanted monster created and animated by a high level magic-user or cleric. Golems can be made of almost any material. The DM should feel free to create new types as desired.
